evidence: Austin, in game (reported 2026-11-26 while leveling): no Forever blacksmithing trainer teaches it. One For All has no fee, recipe item or source for it, so it would count as a trainer recipe.

One For All 6.3.0's teach lists give this recipe only to Leatherworking trainers 7866/7867 (Dragonscale), 7868/7869 (Elemental) or 7870/7871 (Tribal); QuestieDB titles 7870 'Tribal Leatherworking Trainer'. The client's RECIPE_SPEC (ItemSparse RequiredAbility) shows Forever keeps these specializations (spells 10656, 10658, 10660). One For All's fee table has no specialization flag for it.
